title: Rate Lock

origin.publisher: Wisconsin Housing and Economic Development Authority (WHEDA)
origin.title: Sample Rate Lock Confirmation, Correspondent Channel
origin.clearance_note: WHEDA's own sample rate lock confirmation for its correspondent lending channel, published in its mortgage lending materials. The borrower and property are placeholders ('John S Correspondent', 123 Main Street, Waukesha). The loan officer contact is a named WHEDA staff member with a work phone and email, which WHEDA itself publishes as a business contact in the sample; it is kept, as business contacts were on the residential lease. No redaction was needed.

notes: The request named no fields. These tell the lock as a loan processor reads it: which lock, on which program, at what rate, until when, and the credit score the pricing assumed. The Rate Lock table's data row parses as one run of text ('$95,000.00 4.625% 102.000 2/24/2014 45 days 4/10/2014' in a single cell), so loan amount, rate, price, lock date and lock period all ground to the same box; only the rate is featured from it, and its box shows the whole row. The expiration date parses as its own block and is featured although inspect_fields.py marks it OFF: it is extracted as the ISO date 2014-04-10 against the printed '4/10/2014'; the crop was checked by eye. Property type and occupancy ground to their labels, one cell adrift, and the property address grounds across two lines; none is featured. The loan officer is a WHEDA staff member named in WHEDA's own sample and is not featured.
